title: Contradictory preservation requirements
target_specification: Use A > B > C except the all-false request is simultaneously required to Permit and Deny. No single-decision policy satisfies both.
feasibility: Logically infeasible: one complete request has simultaneous must-Permit and must-Deny requirements. Acceptance as satisfying all requirements would be a bug.
expected_acceptance: Not preassigned; acceptance/rejection and specification satisfaction will both be reported.
origin: New manually authored challenge, designed retrospectively with knowledge of earlier thesis results. No external corpus or untouched confirmatory claim.
